extension.description: Remote Pulse — a quiet, native-feeling indicator that continuously tracks your Remote-SSH host's CPU/memory/disk/network/GPU/Docker status.
command.showTrend.title: Remote Pulse: Show Trend Chart
command.refresh.title: Remote Pulse: Refresh Now
command.configureStatusBarMetrics.title: Remote Pulse: Configure Status Bar Metrics
command.configureTrendPanelSections.titl: Remote Pulse: Configure Trend Panel Sections
command.configureTrendChartMetrics.title: Remote Pulse: Configure Trend Chart Metrics
config.refreshInterval.description: Refresh interval for high-frequency foreground metrics (CPU/memory), in milliseconds
config.backgroundInterval.description: Reduced refresh interval used once the window loses focus, in milliseconds
config.heavyMetricInterval.description: Separate polling interval for low-frequency metrics like GPU/Docker, in milliseconds
config.warningThreshold.description: Warning threshold (percentage); the status bar switches to the warning color above it
config.criticalThreshold.description: Critical threshold (percentage); the status bar switches to the critical color above it
config.statusBarMetrics.description: Which metrics to show as status bar items; the rest still appear in the trend panel. Run "Remote Pulse: Configure Status Bar Metrics" from the Command Palette to pick from all options at once.
config.statusBarMetrics.markdownDescript: Which metrics to show as status bar items; the rest still appear in the trend panel. Run `Remote Pulse: Configure Status Bar Metrics` from the Command Palette to pick from all options at once.
config.statusBarMetrics.gpu.description: GPU utilization of the primary GPU only (requires nvidia-smi); all GPUs still appear in the trend panel
config.statusBarMetrics.network.descript: Network download/upload rate, shown separately with arrow icons
config.trendPanelSections.description: Which optional sections to show in the trend panel; System and Storage are always shown. Run "Remote Pulse: Configure Trend Panel Sections" from the Command Palette to pick from all options at once.
config.trendPanelSections.markdownDescri: Which optional sections to show in the trend panel; System and Storage are always shown. Run `Remote Pulse: Configure Trend Panel Sections` from the Command Palette to pick from all options at once.
config.trendPanelSections.network.descri: Network upload/download rate, shown as a row in the panel's System section
config.trendPanelSections.docker.descrip: Docker container info (requires access to docker.sock)
config.trendChartMetrics.description: Which metrics to plot as lines in the trend panel's 30-minute chart; independent of trendPanelSections (which controls the detail sections, not the chart) and statusBarMetrics. Run "Remote Pulse: Configure Trend Chart Metrics" from the Command Palette to pick from all options at once.
config.trendChartMetrics.markdownDescrip: Which metrics to plot as lines in the trend panel's 30-minute chart; independent of `trendPanelSections` (which controls the detail sections, not the chart) and `statusBarMetrics`. Run `Remote Pulse: Configure Trend Chart Metrics` from the Command Palette to pick from all options at once.
config.trendChartMetrics.gpu.description: GPU utilization of the primary GPU only (requires nvidia-smi)
config.trendChartMetrics.network.descrip: Network download/upload rate, plotted as two separate lines on their own right-hand axis
config.enableNotifications.description: Whether to show a system notification when the critical threshold is crossed
config.diskMountPoints.description: Disk mount points to monitor; leave empty to auto-select the one with the highest usage
